definitions.ask: Should hijack also treat a live EPIC APPROVED or PLAN COMMITTED member as RUNNING?
definitions.why: All four labels come from the same RUNNING rewrite, so fixing two leaves the bug on other roles

choices.label: Also map EPIC APPROVED and PLAN COMMITTED to RUNNING when the member's process is alive
Map only WORKING TALE/PLAN; running epic- and commit-role members stay refused
